title: Starry
summary: STARRY, adjective [from star.] 1. Abounding with stars; adorned with stars. Above the clouds, above the starry sky. 2. Consisting of stars; stellar; stellary; proceeding from the stars; as starry ligh

inlines.v: STARRY, adjective [from star.] 1. Abounding with stars; adorned with stars. Above the clouds, above the starry sky. 2. Consisting of stars; stellar; stellary; proceeding from the stars; as starry light; starry flame. 3. Shining like stars; resembling stars; as starry eyes.
